description: This PHP script handles the saving of FAQ records in the vtiger CRM system. It processes form inputs, assigns user or group IDs based on the request, saves the FAQ record, and then redirects the browser to a specified view, typically the detail view of the saved record.

classes.name: Faq
classes.description: Model class representing an FAQ record in the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the FAQ record to the database.
